rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the act of killing in general.

example.english: Killing isn't a way to solve problems.
example.traditional: 殺人唔係解決問題嘅方法。

rows.note: Use this for a particular homicide or killing case, especially one treated as a crime.

example.english: This killing hasn't been solved yet.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 meng6 on3 zung6 mei6 po3
